source: Thille AW, Rodriguez P, Cabello B, et al. Patient-ventilator asynchrony during assisted mechanical ventilation. Intensive Care Med 2006; 32(10):1515-1522; de Wit M, et al. Crit Care 2009; 13(4):R109.
claim: When neural inspiratory time (pmusInspTimeSec 1.4 s) markedly exceeds ventilator inspiratory time (0.5 s in VC-AC with high flow 60 L/min and VT 350 mL) with strong effort (Pmus 16 cmH2O), ongoing patient muscular effort during early exhalation triggers an immediate second breath (double triggering).
